provenance.note: No existing repo artifact was modified; all outputs are new files under stage_c_deploy/diagnostics/. Instrumented ONNX copies are DEBUG copies, never deployment artifacts.

materiality_criterion.rule: MATERIAL iff max_abs_diff > 1e-6 AND relative (max_abs_diff / max_abs_value) > 1e-7; first material stage = earliest in forward order meeting both. Stated BEFORE the numbers.

ties.mapping: cost upsampled with F.interpolate(bilinear, align_corners=True) to (368,1232), then standardised across dim=1 (mean/std + 1e-6, because regression_normalize=True) and softmax(-cost): exact reproduction of src/models/stereonet/regression.py soft_argmin at full resolution, so no approximate low-res cell mapping is used.
